say:2:1330107001:0.text: Guess what? We've caught twenty grouses this time!
say:2:1330107001:0.source_cn: 没错，我们这次足足打了二十只松鸡！
say:2:1330107001:0.male: Guess what? We've caught twenty grouses this time!
say:2:1330107001:0.female: Guess what? We've caught twenty grouses this time!

say:3:1330107002:0.text: Really? I don't think that nest I found yesterday had that many grouses in it...
say:3:1330107002:0.source_cn: 竟然这么多？可我记得昨天发现的那窝松鸡好像没有这么多……

say:4:1330107003:0.text: That's not important! Anyway, with the cash in hand, I'm going to take a nice break.
say:4:1330107003:0.source_cn: 不管了！既然钱到手，接下来我要好好休息一阵子。
